critical_code_review_comments: ChauffeurWelcome.js imports SteeringWheel, CurrencyEur, Clock, MapPin, Star from phosphor-icons but 'Clock' is not used in the slides array (unused import - dead code, minor).

LoginPage.js and ChauffeurLogin.js duplicate the entire 4-option account modal (Apple/Google/Facebook/FaceID) with identical toast messages and Google handler. Consider extracting a shared <OtherLoginOptionsModal /> component (DRY) - code duplication ~60 lines.

ClientWelcome + ChauffeurWelcome splash->welcome transition only fires when !loading; if useAuth() loading flag is stuck (e.g. failed /api/auth/me), the splash hangs forever. Consider adding a max-timeout fallback (e.g. 3000ms) to force transition even if auth call hangs.
AuthContext.loginWithGoogle uses window.location.href which does full page reload; acceptable here but state (like return-to path) is lost. Not a blocker.

Google session endpoint stores phone:null and role:'user' for Google-signup users; chauffeurs who sign in via Google would still get role='user', which may not be intended. If chauffeur is expected to become role=driver when signing via /chauffeur/login Google button, a driver-context flag should be passed to /api/auth/google/session. Currently this is NOT handled - worth flagging to product.
